title: Cagayan fisherfolk receive livelihood assistance to combat impact of Super El Niño

blocks.text: Thirteen fisherfolk groups in Claveria, Cagayan, received vital fishing equipment, boats, and post-harvest facilities through a joint livelihood assistance initiative of the Department of Agriculture–Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (DA-BFAR) and Trabaho party-list, as communities grapple with the severe impacts of El Niño on their livelihoods. The assistance, turned over last week, aims to help local fisherfolk sustain their fishing operations, improve post-harvest handling and marketing, and generate better income amid mounting agricultural losses caused by the climate phenomenon.
